task: Research, art-direct, generate, inspect, and package a coherent ten-image New Earth 2126 Starlight civilization series.
surface: Ten wide cinematic master frames for a repository gallery, editorial sequence, deck, site story, and future film storyboard.
audience: Builders, citizens, researchers, creators, and future generations evaluating a life-affirming Starlight future.
first_read: Reciprocal intelligence among people, artificial systems, water, land, and other species creates visible abundance.

references.label: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of Artificial Intelligence
references.reason: Human dignity, transparency, fairness, environmental responsibility, and human oversight.

references.label: UNEP Cities and the UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration
references.reason: Ecological corridors, wetlands, canals, mangroves, pollinator habitat, and public participation.

references.label: IPBES Nature Futures Framework
references.reason: Plural positive values for nature for nature, nature for society, and nature as culture.

references.label: UNEP Water as a Circular Economy Resource
references.reason: Circular water reuse and resource stewardship.

references.label: FAO Agroforestry
references.reason: Diverse trees, crops, animals, and locally adapted production systems.

references.label: Project CETI Research
references.reason: Low-impact field research, recordings, behavioral context, and machine learning for sperm-whale communication.

references.label: IEA Renewables 2025
references.reason: Contemporary clean-energy transition context for electricity, heat, and transport.

keep: Clear institutional daylight and documentary humanity
Place-specific ecology, water, weather, soil, and tactile materials
Visible stewardship, governance, maintenance, and intergenerational work
Plural non-anthropomorphic artificial intelligences with distinct public responsibilities
One readable subject and deep foreground-middle-background scale
avoid: Dark command centers, neon, glowing orbs, portals, orbit and node graphics
Humanoid robot councils, floating holograms, fake UI, generated text or logos
Glass megacity, flying-car swarms, pasted-on greenery, empty resort utopia
Impossible ecology, mutant animals, malformed anatomy, clone crowds
Generic solarpunk collage, franchise echoes, and living-artist imitation
direction.signature: A thin oxidized-red physical provenance line recurs as real infrastructure connecting action to consequence across all ten frames.
system: Warm mineral white, environmental blues and greens, deep navy as ink, oxidized red as the single intervention color
Large-format documentary and architectural photography language
No text in generated pixels; deterministic captions and marks remain external
Wide crop-safe master compositions with human-scale foreground and planetary consequence

asset_quality.why_premium: Original research-grounded prompts, a coherent authored world, an explicit anti-trope system, and export-by-export visual inspection.

artifacts.notes: Opening scale, hydrology, foreground stewardship, infrastructure, crop safety, anatomy, and provenance line inspected at full frame; pass.
Material plurality of AI, civic evidence action, faces, hands, garden context, and anti-command-center behavior inspected; pass.
Connected water logic, maintenance activity, wetland layers, reflections, topography, and red service edge inspected; pass.
Whale anatomy, animal primacy, over-under waterline, passive research distance, cable, and absence of anthropomorphism inspected; pass.
Foreground handoff, hand anatomy, valley ecology, diverse food layers, public work, crowd integrity, and climate coherence inspected; pass.

Craft focal action, hands, instrument, accessibility, learning depth, and red floor seam inspected; pass. Adaptive instrument is intentionally tool-like and non-authoritative despite a mildly creature-like silhouette.
Four functional intelligence habitats, coherent ridge-to-sea geography, human stewardship, absence of a ruling monument, and route continuity inspected; pass.
Daily-life density, tram, stream, flood-gate maintenance, public accessibility, faces, hands, reflections, and no readable generated signage inspected; pass.
Visible degradation history, branching basin, soil-work foreground, restoration staging, people, machinery, native-herd scale, and survey stakes inspected; pass.
Intergenerational silhouette, quiet instrument, living basin, distant whales, natural stars, archive inlay, twilight exposure, and emotional restraint inspected; pass.

checks.name: asset-tier
checks.evidence: Tier B custom generated world imagery is the correct medium for speculative future style frames.

checks.name: research-grounding
checks.evidence: Local Horizon and Civic Intelligence canon plus primary-source research ledger recorded in README.md.

checks.name: export-inspection
checks.evidence: All ten final PNG masters were opened at original detail and reviewed edge to edge; each decodes at 1672x941 in 24-bit RGB. Checksums are recorded in ASSET-MANIFEST.json.

checks.name: visual-qa
checks.evidence: Reviewed anatomy, faces, hands, animal agency, water, ecological and geographic coherence, text/logo absence, crop safety, scene hierarchy, series continuity, provenance line, and rejected sci-fi tropes. No regeneration was required.

checks.name: independent-critic
checks.evidence: The pre-generation machine admission returned SWARM HOLD because free RAM was below the 10 GB swarm reserve and 16 Codex runtimes exceeded the eight-runtime budget. No new critic agent was started. Maker QA is complete; founder review remains the non-delegated release gate.

score.notes: Maker diagnostic: 5/5 first read, 5/5 outcome coherence, 5/5 visual craft, 5/5 brand alignment, 4/5 distinctiveness, 4/5 release readiness. This is not independent taste approval.

known_risks: Founder selection may request a narrower regional, architectural, or cultural specificity before public release.
Frame 06's adaptive teaching instrument has a mildly creature-like silhouette even though it is faceless, repairable, and subordinate to human learning.
The series is speculative future fiction; captions must preserve the distinction between researched mechanisms and depicted possibilities.
A self-authored diagnostic cannot provide independent taste approval.
